runs.t: To register for and use the Platform, you must: (a) be at least 18 years of age or the age of majority in your jurisdiction, whichever is higher; (b) have the legal capacity to enter into binding contracts; (c) if registering on behalf of a legal entity, have authority to bind that entity to these Terms; (d) not be subject to applicable trade sanctions, export controls, or restrictions; and (e) not have previously had an Account terminated by Operon Softwares for cause.

Registration requires accurate, current, and complete information including your full legal name or entity name, registered business address, contact details, and selected subscription tier. You agree to keep all Account information updated at all times.

Clients may invite internal stakeholders (such as senior executives, auditors, or board members) to access the Platform as view-only guests under their Account. Guest users may view project progress, reports, and Workspace updates but may not submit, approve, or transact. The Account holder is solely responsible for all activity by guest users and must ensure they comply with these Terms. Operon Softwares reserves the right to limit the number of guest users permitted under each subscription tier.

Accounts may not be transferred to a third party without Operon Softwares's prior written consent.

You are solely responsible for ensuring all information provided during registration and throughout your use of the Platform is accurate, complete, and not misleading. You are solely responsible for the consequences of any inaccuracies or omissions.

Operon Softwares operates a compliance-first onboarding model for Operon 360. All Vendors, and Clients who apply to also act as Vendors, must complete a full KYC process before being permitted to transact on the Platform. Clients registering solely as buyers may be subject to a lighter onboarding process, which may be upgraded to full KYC at Operon Softwares's discretion or upon a change in role.
The KYC process may include, without limitation:
Document verification:
submission of government-issued identification, certificate of incorporation, trade licences, GST registrations, professional certifications, and any other documents requested by Operon Softwares.
Background checks:
review of directorships, legal proceedings, sanctions screening, and regulatory history.
Physical verification:
an on-site or third-party-facilitated verification of the User's declared place of business.
Legal and regulatory review:
assessment of compliance with applicable industry-specific regulations.
Ongoing periodic re-verification as required by applicable law or Operon Softwares policy.

If Operon Softwares determines that a User does not meet its KYC requirements, Operon Softwares will notify the User of the rejection. A rejected User may submit a written appeal to [KYC APPEAL EMAIL] within 14 days of receiving the rejection notice, providing additional documentation or clarification. Operon Softwares will review the appeal and communicate its final decision within [NUMBER] business days. Operon Softwares's final decision on KYC appeals is binding.

Where a User has paid Subscription fees prior to a KYC rejection, Operon Softwares will refund the unused portion of the prepaid Subscription fees on a pro-rata basis, provided that the rejection was not caused by the User's submission of false, fraudulent, or misleading information. No refund shall be issued where rejection results from the User's own misrepresentation.

You are solely responsible for ensuring that all documents and information submitted during KYC are authentic, accurate, complete, and lawfully obtained. Submission of false, forged, or misleading documents is a material breach of these Terms and may constitute a criminal offence. Operon Softwares reserves the right to report suspected fraud to relevant authorities.

Operon Softwares reserves the sole and absolute discretion to approve, defer, reject, or re-verify any User at any stage. This discretion does not create any obligation on Operon Softwares to provide reasons and shall not give rise to any claim for compensation, except as set out in Section 4.3.

Operon Softwares may engage third-party identity verification or due diligence providers to assist with KYC. By submitting your information, you consent to such information being shared with these providers as described in our Privacy Policy.

blocks.text: Subscriptions, Department Head Access, and Account Management

runs.t: Access to the Platform is conditional upon the purchase of an applicable Subscription. Subscription plans, including pricing, features, and included access levels, are set out on the Platform and may be updated with appropriate notice as described in Section 25.

Users may upgrade their Subscription plan at any time. An upgrade takes effect immediately and the User will be charged the pro-rata difference for the remainder of the current billing period, based on the number of days remaining.

Users may downgrade their Subscription plan at any time. A downgrade takes effect at the start of the next billing period. No refund or credit is issued for the unused portion of the current period upon a downgrade. Operon Softwares will notify the User of any features or access that will be removed as a result of the downgrade, and the User is responsible for ensuring any data or configurations dependent on the higher-tier features are addressed before the downgrade takes effect.

During Subscription setup and at any time thereafter, Users may designate specific department heads or senior representatives within their organisation to receive elevated access to relevant Platform features and workflows (“Department Head Access”). Users are responsible for designating appropriate individuals and may add or remove Department Head Access at any time through the Account settings. Operon Softwares does not independently verify the authority of designated individuals within the User's organisation. The User is solely responsible for all actions taken by individuals granted Department Head Access.

If a Client's Subscription lapses due to non-renewal or non-payment, access to the Platform will be suspended in accordance with Section 20. In such circumstances: (a) all active Project Workspaces associated with the Account will be placed into a read-only state for a grace period of [NUMBER] days; (b) the Client will be notified and given the opportunity to renew the Subscription within the grace period to restore full access; (c) if the Subscription is not renewed within the grace period, active Workspaces will be archived and Vendors and PMs will be notified; and (d) any pending POs or payment obligations arising prior to lapse remain due and payable.
Operon 360 provides an integrated B2B platform offering, among other things:
A requirement and proposal management system for Clients and Vendors.
AI-assisted analytics, recommendations, and workflow automation.
A procurement powered by Graviyx Marketplace for sourcing, quoting, and purchasing goods and services.
Project Workspaces for collaborative project execution.
A Tender facility for multi-vendor procurement powered by Graviyx exercises.
Warranty claim management and post-sales service coordination.
Billing, subscription, and financial management tools.

Upon successful onboarding, a Client may: (a) submit requirements through the Platform; (b) receive Vendor recommendations and Proposals; (c) approve Proposals and initiate a Project Workspace; (d) issue Tenders; (e) procure products and services; (f) manage projects, milestones, approvals, and budgets within the Workspace; and (g) submit Warranty Claims and post-sales service requests.

Upon successful onboarding, a Vendor may: (a) create and maintain a product and services portfolio; (b) appear in the procurement powered by Graviyx Marketplace; (c) receive and respond to Tenders; (d) participate in Project Workspaces; (e) manage purchase orders, quotations, and post-sales obligations; and (f) access sales projections and material forecasts as provided by the Platform.

Operon Softwares does not guarantee that: (a) a particular Vendor will be matched to or selected for a Client's requirement; (b) a Vendor's bid will be accepted for a Tender; (c) a Client's procurement powered by Graviyx will be fulfilled within any particular timeframe; or (d) any recommendation produced by the Platform will be accurate or complete. All platform operations are subject to system availability, applicable regulatory requirements, and Operon Softwares's operational policies.

The Platform incorporates artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to assist Users with tasks such as requirement analysis, vendor matching, procurement powered by Graviyx recommendations, project workflow support, market forecasting, and data structuring (collectively, “AI Features”). AI Features are provided as a convenience to improve operational efficiency.

AI outputs do not constitute and must not be treated as professional, legal, financial, technical, engineering, medical, regulatory, or commercial advice of any kind. Users must seek independent professional advice before relying on any AI output for material business decisions, compliance determinations, or contractual commitments. Operon Softwares expressly disclaims any liability arising from a User's reliance on AI outputs as a substitute for professional advice.

By using the Platform, you consent to Operon Softwares processing the Content and data you submit through the Platform using AI systems for the purpose of delivering the AI Features described in these Terms and the Privacy Policy. This includes processing your requirements, project data, procurement powered by Graviyx history, and communications to generate recommendations, analytics, and workflow support. You may withdraw consent to certain AI processing by contacting [PRIVACY CONTACT EMAIL], subject to the limitations set out in Section 7.4.

Operon Softwares may apply human review and oversight by its specialist teams to supplement or override AI-generated outputs. The application of human review does not guarantee the accuracy or completeness of any output.

Operon Softwares makes no warranty that the AI Features will be error-free, uninterrupted, or produce any specific result. Operon Softwares shall not be liable for any loss arising from reliance on AI-generated outputs, except to the extent that liability cannot be excluded under applicable law.

blocks.text: Procurement powered by Graviyx , Tenders, Quotations, and Purchase Flows

runs.t: The procurement powered by Graviyx Marketplace enables Clients to source, evaluate, and procure goods and services from verified Vendors. Listings are subject to Operon Softwares's approval and may be updated, removed, or modified by Operon Softwares at any time.

Clients may publish requirements as a Tender through the Platform. Operon Softwares retains sole discretion to determine which Vendors are eligible to receive and respond to a Tender, to review and shortlist bids, and to assist the Client in vendor selection. Operon Softwares's involvement is facilitative only; the final selection and resulting contract are the responsibility of the Client and Vendor.

All bids submitted by Vendors in response to a Tender are strictly confidential. Vendors are prohibited from disclosing their own bid terms, pricing, or any related communications to other Vendors or to any third party. Operon Softwares will not disclose the content of one Vendor's bid to another Vendor participating in the same Tender. Any Vendor found to have disclosed bid information to a competitor or to have colluded with other bidders will be immediately disqualified from the Tender and may have their Account suspended or terminated.

blocks.text: Bid Bond and Earnest Money Deposits

runs.t: Where Operon Softwares or a Client specifies that a Tender requires a bid bond, earnest money deposit, or similar financial security (“Bid Security”), this requirement will be specified in the Tender documentation. The terms of any Bid Security, including the amount, form, conditions for forfeiture, and process for return, will be set out in the relevant Tender documents. Failure to provide a required Bid Security by the specified deadline will result in disqualification from the Tender. Operon Softwares is not responsible for the administration of Bid Securities except where it has expressly agreed to act as custodian in writing.

blocks.text: Vendor Failure to Execute after Tender Award

runs.t: If a Vendor is awarded a Tender and subsequently fails or refuses to execute the resulting contract or fulfil the awarded obligations without a valid legal justification, Operon Softwares may: (a) immediately disqualify the Vendor from future Tenders on the Platform; (b) forfeit any Bid Security lodged by the Vendor; (c) suspend or terminate the Vendor's Account; and (d) notify the affected Client and assist in sourcing an alternative Vendor. The Client's recourse for losses arising from the Vendor's failure shall be against the Vendor directly; Operon Softwares shall not be liable for such losses except where they arise from Operon Softwares's own breach.

Quotations submitted by Vendors may be reviewed and processed by Operon Softwares's Finance Team before being presented to the Client. POs issued through the Platform are binding upon acceptance. Users agree to honour all POs duly accepted through the Platform.

A confirmed PO may only be cancelled in the following circumstances: (a) by mutual written agreement of the Client and Vendor, confirmed through the Platform; (b) by the Client, where the Vendor has materially failed to commence performance within the agreed timeframe and has not remedied the failure within [NUMBER] days of written notice; or (c) by the Vendor, where the Client has failed to make a required advance payment and has not remedied the failure within [NUMBER] days of written notice. Cancellation of a confirmed PO outside of these circumstances may give rise to liability for costs incurred, cancellation fees, and other damages as specified in the relevant contract or as determined by applicable law. Users must submit all PO cancellation requests through the Platform's designated cancellation workflow.

blocks.text: Delivery, Logistics, and Risk of Loss

runs.t: Unless otherwise agreed in a specific contract, the terms of delivery, shipping, and logistics for physical goods procured through the Platform shall be as specified in the relevant PO or contract. Risk of loss or damage to goods passes from the Vendor to the Client in accordance with the delivery terms agreed in the relevant PO (for example, EXW, FOB, CIF, DDP, as applicable). Operon Softwares is not a logistics provider and is not responsible for shipping, customs clearance, import duties, or the condition of goods in transit, unless Operon Softwares has expressly contracted to provide logistics services in writing.

Upon delivery of goods or completion of services, the Client has [NUMBER] calendar days (“Inspection Period”) to inspect the goods or services and notify Operon Softwares and the Vendor in writing of any defects, non-conformities, or shortfalls. Failure to raise a written notification within the Inspection Period shall be deemed acceptance of the goods or services as conforming, subject to any latent defects that could not reasonably have been discovered during inspection. Inspection notifications must be submitted through the designated Workspace or support channel.

Where a Client has raised a valid defect or non-conformity notification within the Inspection Period, the Vendor must, at its election or as agreed with the Client: (a) replace the non-conforming goods or re-perform the non-conforming services within a reasonable period; or (b) issue a credit or refund for the non-conforming portion. The return logistics for non-conforming goods shall be arranged and paid for by the Vendor unless otherwise agreed. This return and replacement right is separate from and in addition to any Warranty rights described in Section 14.
Upon approval of a Client-Vendor engagement, Operon Softwares will activate a dedicated Project Workspace accessible to the relevant Client, Vendor(s), and assigned PM.

The Workspace provides a secure collaborative environment for project planning, milestone tracking, procurement powered by Graviyx management, document sharing, approval workflows, communication, and budget management. All Workspace activities must be limited to the legitimate purposes of the project and must comply with these Terms.

Each Milestone within a Workspace will be formally presented to the Client for approval through the Platform's milestone sign-off workflow. A Milestone is deemed approved when the designated Client representative submits an explicit written approval through the Platform. Verbal approvals, approvals communicated off-platform, or failure to respond within the specified review period do not constitute approval. Where a Client does not respond to a milestone sign-off request within [NUMBER] business days, Operon Softwares may send a reminder notice; continued non-response for a further [NUMBER] business days may be treated as deemed acceptance at Operon Softwares's discretion and upon prior written notice to the Client.

blocks.text: Adding or Replacing a Vendor in an Active Workspace

runs.t: Operon Softwares may, with the Client's consent, add or replace a Vendor within an active Workspace where: (a) the original Vendor has failed to meet its obligations; (b) the scope of the project has expanded to require additional capabilities; or (c) the original Vendor has withdrawn or been removed in accordance with these Terms. Before a new or replacement Vendor is added, Operon Softwares will ensure the incoming Vendor has completed the applicable KYC process. The incoming Vendor will be granted access to Workspace documents and history relevant to their scope of work, subject to confidentiality protections.

Where a Vendor is removed from a Workspace, whether at the Client's request, due to a breach of these Terms, or for any other reason: (a) the removed Vendor's active access to the Workspace will be immediately revoked; (b) the removed Vendor will retain view-only access to documentation relating to their own completed or ongoing deliverables for a period of [NUMBER] days for record-keeping purposes, unless restricted by Operon Softwares for cause; (c) all Content contributed by the removed Vendor to the Workspace remains within the Workspace and accessible to the Client and PM; and (d) the removed Vendor's confidentiality obligations in respect of Workspace content continue in accordance with Section 18.

A Client may cancel an active project by providing written notice through the Platform. Upon cancellation: (a) the Client shall remain liable for all costs, committed expenditure, approved Milestones, and POs issued prior to the cancellation notice; (b) Operon Softwares will facilitate the orderly wind-down of the Workspace, including final invoicing and documentation; (c) a cancellation notice period of [NUMBER] days applies, during which the Vendor and PM will complete or document all in-progress activities; and (d) any cancellation fees specified in the relevant contract or applicable subscription terms will apply. Cancellation does not relieve the Client of outstanding payment obligations.

The assigned PM oversees all aspects of project delivery within the Workspace. The PM's oversight does not make Operon Softwares liable for the performance of the Vendor or the quality of goods and services delivered.

Operon Softwares may close or archive a Workspace upon project completion, termination of the engagement, or material breach of these Terms. Archived Workspace data will be retained in accordance with Operon Softwares's data retention policy.

blocks.text: Fees, Payments, Billing, and Financial Terms

runs.t: Access to the Platform is conditional upon purchase of an applicable Subscription. Subscription plans and pricing are set out on the Platform and may be updated with appropriate notice. By selecting a Subscription, you agree to pay the applicable fees in accordance with the selected billing cycle.

All fees are invoiced and payable in advance unless otherwise agreed in writing. You authorise Operon Softwares (or its designated payment processor) to charge your payment method for all applicable fees. Failure to pay fees when due may result in suspension or termination of your Account.

Operon 360 operates on a Milestone-Based Payment Model for specific transactions or Subscriptions, under which the following terms apply: (a) the Client funds each agreed Milestone to Operon Softwares before the Vendor begins work on that Milestone; (b) once the Vendor marks the Milestone complete and the Client reviews and approves it, the corresponding payment is released to the Vendor; (c) Operon Softwares acts as a facilitative intermediary and payment custodian in respect of Milestone-Based payments and is not a licensed payment institution or bank unless expressly stated; (d) Milestone payments will be disbursed or refunded in accordance with the outcome of the relevant transaction, dispute resolution process, or applicable law; and (e) Operon Softwares may charge a Milestone-Based Payment facilitation fee as disclosed at the time of the transaction.

The Platform currently supports transactions in Indian Rupees (INR) only. Multi-currency support is planned for future international phases (including the United States, Australia, and the United Kingdom) and is not currently available. Where a transaction involves a currency conversion, the applicable exchange rate will be the rate applied by Operon Softwares's payment processor at the time of the transaction, which may include a conversion spread or fee. Exchange rate fluctuations between the time a PO is issued and the time of payment are the responsibility of the transacting parties. Operon Softwares does not guarantee any specific exchange rate and is not liable for losses arising from currency fluctuations.

All fees are exclusive of applicable taxes, levies, duties, or charges imposed by any governmental authority. You are responsible for paying all applicable taxes associated with your use of the Platform. Where Operon Softwares is required to collect taxes on your behalf, the applicable amount will be added to your invoice.

Amounts not paid by the due date shall accrue interest at the rate of [RATE]% per month (or the maximum rate permitted by applicable law, whichever is lower) from the due date until payment. Operon Softwares reserves the right to suspend access to the Platform for any Account with overdue amounts.

Where a User's Account is suspended for any reason, all pending payment obligations remain due and payable. Pending outbound payments to Vendors that are funded under the Milestone-Based Payment Model or awaiting release will remain pending resolution of the matter giving rise to the suspension. Operon Softwares will not release those funds to either party during the period of a suspension unless required by a court order or arbitral award, or unless the suspension is lifted. Upon reinstatement of the Account, pending payments will be processed in accordance with the applicable transaction terms.

Subscription fees paid in advance are generally non-refundable, except: (a) as set out in Section 4.3 (KYC rejection refund); (b) where required by applicable consumer protection law; or (c) where Operon Softwares has materially failed to provide the agreed Services and the failure is not remedied within 30 days of written notice.
